subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should OpenClaw accept this default-off iterationBudget config plus onBeforeToolCallingRound/supportsIterationBudget harness contract as the public shape for agent loop safety?
rationale: The patch appears technically sound, but it adds operator config and a harness capability contract whose naming, defaults, and fail-closed behavior are product/API decisions rather than deterministic review outcomes.

options.title: Accept This Contract
options.body: Keep the default-off iterationBudget fields and harness opt-in/fail-closed behavior, then refresh conflicts and proceed through normal merge gates.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Keep the safety mechanism but revise names, defaults, or hook shape before making this a public config and harness contract.

options.title: Defer To Broader Budget Design
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want per-channel, per-tool-call, or auto-delegation budgets designed before adding an agent-level limit.

recommendation.title: Accept This Contract
recommendation.body: Keep the default-off iterationBudget fields and harness opt-in/fail-closed behavior, then refresh conflicts and proceed through normal merge gates.
